author: staurum
text:
I have read RTM materials for over a month now, and i have a confession
to make: the more i learn, the more i realise how much i do not know.
The more AHA moments I found, the more times I am discouraged by the
market invalidating the AHA moments. Just when I yelled "yes i knew it",
 the more the market will spank me "nope, dont be so cocky, there s more
 to learn, here s us (the Market / ITs) taking your stoploss, go back to
 RTM and suck your losses up! then comeback here and challenge us".

Funny that lastnight, there was a "Deadpool" movie showing on my TV. The
 hard painful irony that i thought was : maybe all newbies are inherited
 with the market-infected cancer. In order to cure the newbies, ones
have to through extreme gruelling sets of procedures (and please dont
forget the pains) until the body (trader mindset) mutates to heal/cure
itself. If not strong, you'll just burn and die. If succeeds, the ugly
scars never leave forever. Blessing or curse? how rethoric.

Ok now, back to the chart. I have marked all the numbers to express my
thought flow that follows the chart order flow. I am not going to write
down what i thought at each numbered checkpoint as I do not want to bore
 and discourage the true curious, truth/price-reading seeker.. Just to
help those who are confused, please look at left when you come to any
checkpoint. Cheers, more to come later.
